title: God Is Near
body: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit. Today remember that God is not distant from your pain.
question: Where do you feel brokenhearted or discouraged right now?
prayer: Lord, draw near to me in the places I feel weak and remind me that I am not alone.

title: New Every Morning
body: God’s mercies are new every morning. Yesterday’s failures do not disqualify you from walking with Him today.
question: What regret or failure from yesterday are you still carrying?
prayer: Father, thank You for new mercies today. Help me walk in them instead of replaying my past.

title: He Knows Your Name
body: God calls you by name and claims you as His own. You are not forgotten or anonymous to Him.
question: Where do you feel unseen or overlooked by others?
prayer: Jesus, thank You that You know my name. Help me rest in being fully known and fully loved by You.

title: Anxious Hearts
body: God invites you to bring every anxiety to Him with prayer and thanksgiving. His peace guards hearts and minds even when circumstances do not change.
question: What is making you most anxious today?
prayer: Lord, here is what I am anxious about today. I give it to You and ask for Your guarding peace.

title: Strength in Weakness
body: God’s power is made perfect in weakness, not in polished strength. You do not have to pretend to be strong for Him to work.
question: Where do you feel most inadequate or weak right now?
prayer: Jesus, I offer You my weakness. Show Your strength in the place I feel most limited.

title: He Cares
body: Casting your cares on God is not a single moment but a posture of trust. You can keep bringing the same burden back to Him.
question: What burden do you keep picking back up after you have prayed about it?
prayer: Lord, help me truly trust that You care about this burden and that Your hands are better than my grip.

title: Rest for Your Soul
body: Jesus offers rest for weary souls, not just for tired bodies. His yoke is easy and His burden is light compared with the weight we try to carry alone.
question: What burden are you carrying that feels heavy on your soul?
prayer: Jesus, I come to You with my weariness and burdens. Teach my soul to find rest in You today.
